statement.ru: Гавайский вулкан Мауна-Кеа выше Эвереста, если мерить от подножия на дне.
statement.en: Measured from its base on the sea floor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea is taller than Everest.

why: Mauna Kea rises about 10,000 m from its base on the ocean floor, more than Everest's 8,849 m.

statement.ru: Сталактиты растут из пола пещеры вверх.
statement.en: Stalactites grow upward from the cave floor.

why: Stalactites hang from the ceiling; the ones rising from the floor are stalagmites.

statement.ru: Внутреннее ядро Земли — твёрдый шар, а не жидкость.
statement.en: The Earth's inner core is a solid ball, not a liquid.

why: The inner core is a solid iron-nickel ball about 1,230 km in radius; only the outer core is liquid.

statement.ru: Алмаз выдержит любой удар молотка.
statement.en: A diamond will survive any hammer blow.

why: Diamond is hard (scratch-resistant) but not tough: a steel hammer can shatter it.

statement.ru: Тихий океан в самом широком месте больше чем в пять раз шире Луны.
statement.en: At its widest, the Pacific Ocean is more than five times wider than the Moon.

why: The Pacific spans about 19,800 km at 5°N, more than five times the Moon's 3,474 km diameter.

statement.ru: В Антарктиде есть действующий вулкан.
statement.en: Antarctica has an active volcano.

why: Mount Erebus in Antarctica is the southernmost active volcano, with a lava lake in its crater.

statement.ru: Большая часть лавы на Земле извергается на суше.
statement.en: Most of the Earth's lava erupts on land.

why: Volcanoes on the mid-ocean ridges alone account for about 75% of Earth's magma output.

statement.ru: Больше двух третей пресной воды Земли заморожено во льдах.
statement.en: More than two thirds of the Earth's fresh water is frozen in ice.

why: About 68.7% of all fresh water is frozen in ice caps and glaciers; groundwater holds most of the rest, rivers and lakes about 1%.

statement.ru: Изумруд — это зелёный алмаз.
statement.en: An emerald is a green diamond.

why: Emerald is green beryl, coloured by chromium; it has nothing to do with diamond.

statement.ru: В драгоценном опале есть вода.
statement.en: A precious opal contains water.

why: Opal holds 3 to 21% water by weight, usually 6 to 10%.

statement.ru: Рубин и сапфир — это один и тот же минерал.
statement.en: Ruby and sapphire are the same mineral.

why: Both are corundum: red corundum is ruby, every other colour is sapphire.

statement.ru: Гималаи давно перестали расти.
statement.en: The Himalayas stopped growing long ago.

why: India still pushes into Asia, and the Himalayas rise by about 5 mm a year.

statement.ru: Янтарь можно поджечь, и он будет гореть.
statement.en: Amber can be set alight and will burn.

why: Amber is fossil tree resin; it burns with a smell like pine torches (German Bernstein, 'burn stone').

statement.ru: Зыбучий песок может затянуть человека с головой.
statement.en: Quicksand can suck a person under, head and all.

why: Quicksand is about twice as dense as a person; you cannot sink past about the waist.

statement.ru: Самый высокий водопад на Земле находится под водой.
statement.en: The tallest waterfall on Earth is under water.

why: NOAA: the Denmark Strait cataract, where cold water plunges about 3.5 km down the sea floor, is Earth's largest waterfall, far taller than Angel Falls (979 m).

statement.ru: Сахара — это в основном песчаные дюны.
statement.en: The Sahara is mostly sand dunes.

why: Only about 25% of the Sahara is sand; most is rocky plateaus (hamada) and gravel plains.

statement.ru: В Сахаре есть горы выше трёх километров.
statement.en: The Sahara has mountains more than three kilometres high.

why: Emi Koussi in Chad, the highest peak of the Sahara, is about 3,415 to 3,447 m high.

statement.ru: Айсберги состоят из замёрзшей солёной морской воды.
statement.en: Icebergs are made of frozen salty seawater.

why: Icebergs break off glaciers and ice shelves, so they are freshwater ice.

statement.ru: Солнце тоже вызывает приливы на Земле.
statement.en: The Sun causes tides on Earth too.

why: The Sun's tidal force is about 46% of the Moon's; together they make spring tides.

statement.ru: Больше всего гейзеров в мире — в Исландии.
statement.en: Iceland has the most geysers in the world.

why: Yellowstone in the USA holds about half of the world's geysers; Iceland only gave them their name.

statement.ru: Исландию медленно разрывают две расходящиеся плиты.
statement.en: Iceland is slowly being pulled apart by two plates moving away from each other.

why: The Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a divergent plate boundary, crosses Iceland and spreads about 2.5 cm a year.

statement.ru: Землетрясения чаще случаются в жаркую безветренную погоду.
statement.en: Earthquakes happen more often in hot, still weather.

why: 'Earthquake weather' is a myth: USGS says quakes start far below the reach of weather.

statement.ru: Самая длинная горная цепь Земли скрыта под водой.
statement.en: The longest mountain range on Earth is hidden under water.

why: The mid-ocean ridge runs about 65,000 km under the sea, the longest mountain range in the world.

statement.ru: Йеллоустонский вулкан давно потух.
statement.en: The Yellowstone volcano went extinct long ago.

why: Yellowstone's volcanic field remains active, with quakes, ground uplift and hot springs.

statement.ru: Бывают пляжи с зелёным песком.
statement.en: There are beaches with green sand.

why: Papakōlea Beach in Hawaii is green from olivine crystals eroded from a volcanic cone.

statement.ru: Гавайские острова выросли из коралловых рифов.
statement.en: The Hawaiian Islands grew out of coral reefs.

why: The Hawaiian Islands are the peaks of volcanoes built over a hotspot.

statement.ru: Часть песка на тропических пляжах — это помёт рыб-попугаев.
statement.en: Some of the sand on tropical beaches is parrotfish poo.

why: Parrotfish grind coral and excrete it as sand; one fish can make 90 kg a year.

statement.ru: Алмазы образуются из сжатого угля.
statement.en: Diamonds form from compressed coal.

why: A common misconception: most diamonds are older than the first land plants, so not from coal.

statement.ru: Подо льдом Антарктиды прячутся сотни озёр с жидкой водой.
statement.en: Hundreds of lakes of liquid water hide under the ice of Antarctica.

why: More than 400 subglacial lakes are known in Antarctica, kept liquid by heat from below and the ice's pressure.

statement.ru: Северный полюс находится на суше.
statement.en: The North Pole is on land.

why: The North Pole lies in the middle of the Arctic Ocean, on drifting sea ice over water 4 km deep.

statement.ru: В одной пещере в Мексике есть кристаллы длиннее 10 метров.
statement.en: A cave in Mexico has crystals more than 10 metres long.

why: The Cave of the Crystals at Naica holds gypsum crystals up to 11.4 m long.

statement.ru: Учёные умеют предсказать сильное землетрясение за несколько дней.
statement.en: Scientists can predict a big earthquake a few days ahead.

why: USGS: no scientist has ever predicted a major earthquake; they can only give probabilities over years.

statement.ru: Река Конго дважды пересекает экватор.
statement.en: The Congo River crosses the equator twice.

why: The Congo is the only major river to cross the equator twice.

statement.ru: Фудзияма — потухший вулкан.
statement.en: Mount Fuji is an extinct volcano.

why: Fuji is an active stratovolcano; it last erupted in 1707.

statement.ru: Бывают озёра с ярко-розовой водой.
statement.en: Some lakes have bright pink water.

why: Lake Hillier in Australia is bubble-gum pink, coloured by the alga Dunaliella salina.

statement.ru: Мёртвое море соединено с океаном.
statement.en: The Dead Sea is connected to the ocean.

why: The Dead Sea is a landlocked lake with no outlet, about 440 m below sea level.

statement.ru: Есть вулкан, чья чёрная лава, остывая, становится белой как снег.
statement.en: There is a volcano whose black lava turns snow-white as it cools.

why: Ol Doinyo Lengai in Tanzania erupts black carbonatite lava that turns white within hours to days.

statement.ru: Один грамм золота можно расплющить в лист площадью в квадратный метр.
statement.en: One gram of gold can be beaten into a sheet a square metre in size.

why: Gold is so malleable that a single gram can be beaten into a 1 m² sheet.

statement.ru: Мрамор — это застывшая вулканическая лава.
statement.en: Marble is hardened volcanic lava.

why: Marble is a metamorphic rock: limestone or dolomite changed by heat and pressure, not lava.

statement.ru: Белые скалы Дувра сложены из остатков крошечных водорослей.
statement.en: The White Cliffs of Dover are made of the remains of tiny algae.

why: The chalk formed from coccoliths, the skeletons of tiny algae that sank to the sea floor.
